d: Seaside beach in the vicinity of Caldora. On the front of the scene there is an ancient monastery, the place of a solitaire. At the start of the curtain, a horrible storm has already begun. I saw a ship in grave danger, thrown here and there by the winds and the waves. The shore and the rocks are full of Fishers, who strive to rescue the poor, near to shipwreck. The Solitaire encourages him. Little by little the whole place is covered with Popolo. The storm is at its height.
The Choirs leave hasty; meanwhile, the Naufraghi rescued by the Fishers come from the shores. Gualtiero supported by Itulbo is in their midst. The Solitaire comes to them with great interest.
Fishermen, returning, and sayings.
Lonely, Itulbo and Pirates.
Imogene, Adele, Damigelle and sayings.
It lodges in the castle of Caldora, which puts in the gardens. It is night. Pirates enter drinking and abandoning themselves to the messy joy. Itulbo then overcomes to brake them.
Imogene, and Adele.
Imogene, then Gualtiero.
Imogene and Damigelle, go to Adele.
Exterior of the Palazzo di Caldora, illuminated. Military march; applause of the Knights; then Ernesto.
Imogene, Adele, Damigelle, and sayings. Ernesto goes to meet Imogene.
Lonely, Gualtiero, Itulbo, Pirates and sayings.
Room that puts in the rooms of Imogene. Damigelle's Choir, and Adele.
Adele and Imogene.
Ernesto and said.
There is a Knight, who delivers a sheet to Ernesto.
Lodge in the castle of Caldora as in the first act. Dawn is near. Gualtiero and Itulbo.
Imogene and Gualtiero.
Ernesto at the end of the scene, and sayings.
Adele, Imogene and Damigelle.

Land atrium in the castle: on the sides of the walls, which place the other rooms: in front of large arches, beyond which you can see the outside; with waterfall, on which a bridge passes, leading to the castle. At the sound of gloomy march the soldiers of Ernesto enter with the arms of him, and make a trophy. - Then the Knights come, all afflicted and thoughtful, then Adele and the Damigelle. Everyone group around the trophy.
From one of the galleries of the bottom is advanced Gualtiero revolted in his mantle, in dark and thoughtful air.
Adele and Damigelle.
Imogene, holding his son by the hand, slips in slow steps, looking around lost.
Gualtiero in the midst of the Guards, and Knights, in Itulbo and Pirates, last Imogene with his Damigelle.
